name: WireMat
description: Material for use with the Wire classes. In conjunction with the corresponding functors it can be used to model steel wire meshes [Thoeni2014]_, geotextiles [Cheng2016]_ and more.

attributes.name: diameter
attributes.description: Diameter of the single wire in [m] (the diameter is used to compute the cross-section area of the wire).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Three different types are considered: == =============================================================== 0 Corresponds to Bertrand's approach (see (Bertrand2008)): only one stress-strain curve is used 1 New approach: two separate stress-strain curves can be used (see (Thoeni2013)) 2 New approach with stochastically distorted contact model: two separate stress-strain curves with changed initial stiffness and horizontal shift (shift is random if $ text{seed} geq0$, for more details see (Thoeni2013)) == =============================================================== By default the type is 0.

attributes.name: strainStressValues
attributes.description: Piecewise linear definition of the stress-strain curve by set of points (strain[-]>0,stress[Pa]>0) for one single wire. Tension only is considered and the point (0,0) is not needed! NOTE: Vector needs to be initialized!

attributes.name: strainStressValuesDT
attributes.description: Piecewise linear definition of the stress-strain curve by set of points (strain[-]>0,stress[Pa]>0) for the double twist. Tension only is considered and the point (0,0) is not needed! If this value is given the calculation will be based on two different stress-strain curves without considering the parameter introduced by (Bertrand2008) (see (Thoeni2013)).

attributes.name: isDoubleTwist
attributes.description: Type of the mesh. If true two particles of the same material which body ids differ by one will be considered as double-twisted interaction.

attributes.name: lambdaEps
attributes.description: Parameter between 0 and 1 to reduce strain at failure of a double-twisted wire (as used by (Bertrand2008)). [-]

attributes.name: lambdak
attributes.description: Parameter between 0 and 1 to compute the elastic stiffness of a double-twisted wire (as used by (Bertrand2008)): $k^D=2( lambda_k k_h + (1- lambda_k)k^S)$. [-]

attributes.name: seed
attributes.description: Integer used to initialize the random number generator for the calculation of the distortion. If the integer is equal to 0 a internal seed number based on the time is computed. [-]

attributes.name: lambdau
attributes.description: Parameter between 0 and 1 introduced by (Thoeni2013) which defines the maximum shift of the force-displacement curve in order to take an additional initial elongation (e.g. wire distortion/imperfections, slipping, system flexibility) into account: $ Delta l^*= lambda_u l_0 text{rnd(seed)}$. [-]

attributes.name: lambdaF
attributes.description: Parameter between 0 and 1 introduced by (Thoeni2013) which defines where the shifted force-displacement curve intersects with the new initial stiffness: $F^*= lambda_F F_{ text{elastic}}$. [-]

attributes.name: as
attributes.description: Cross-section area of a single wire used to transform stress into force. [m²]

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Numeric id of this material; is non-negative only if this Material is shared (i.e. in O.materials), -1 otherwise. This value is set automatically when the material is inserted to the simulation via O.materials.append. (This id was necessary since before boost::serialization was used, shared pointers were not tracked properly; it might disappear in the future)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual identifier for this material; can be used for shared materials lookup in MaterialContainer.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: newAssocState
methods.description: Return new State instance, which is associated with this Material. Some materials have special requirement on state type and calling this function when the body is created will ensure that they match. (This is done automatically if you use utils.sphere, … functions from python).

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
